description: OCR/parse any document to text; optionally classify its Japanese document kind. Multi-page PDFs are split and processed page-by-page.

classify.description: Also classify the JP document kind.

content_base64.description: Alternative to path: the file bytes, base64-encoded.

filename.description: Filename (used to infer type); required with content_base64.

mime.description: Optional explicit content type (else inferred from the filename).
